Bid Summary.value: Austin Independent School District requires a refresh of student and administrative laptops for high school campuses across the district under solicitation AISD-2025-9988. The procurement scope includes 1,200 units of Lenovo ThinkPad L15 Gen 5 laptops equipped with Intel Core Ultra 7 processors, 16GB RAM, and 512GB SSDs, alongside 1,200 units of Lenovo USB-C Universal Docks. Additional deliverables include a Lenovo 3-Year Premier Support with Onsite Next Business Day warranty, warranty certificates or affidavits, and a Mercury Affidavit. Proposals are due by December 18, 2025, and equipment delivery is expected within 30 days of award.
